component: Account Hub manual configuration review and continuation

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing makes the manual caller continue only when the test returns a complete configuration with no changes in its listed server fields. Prior-to-submitted edits and submitted-to-tested changes instead show the updated-settings review state and require another tested Continue attempt. The Boolean permits the next validation stage; that stage may still prompt for a password rather than create an account. Stubbed tests assert changed/unchanged routing and call counts, not authenticated connectivity or completed account creation.
title: Account Hub Continue pauses only for named configuration changes or an unsuccessful test
